name: hunter-io
description: Funding intelligence for Hungarian companies — live EU and national calls, deterministic eligibility screening and ranked opportunities

scripts.scrape:open: python "scraping data/scrapping data from ec.europa.eu funding-tenders/funding_tenders_scraper.py" --type grants --status open --max-records 900 --page-size 100 --output data/raw/eu_open_grants.jsonl
scripts.scrape:forthcoming: python "scraping data/scrapping data from ec.europa.eu funding-tenders/funding_tenders_scraper.py" --type grants --status forthcoming --max-records 900 --page-size 100 --output data/raw/eu_forthcoming_grants.jsonl
scripts.scrape:benchmarks: python "scraping data/scrapping data from kohesio.ec.europa.eu/kohesio_scraper.py" --country HU --period 2021-2027 --limit 50 --max-records 400 --fetch-details --output data/raw/kohesio_hungary.jsonl
scripts.refresh: npm run scrape:open && npm run scrape:forthcoming && npm run build:catalog

author: Aetherpontis
